QuestInfo.name: The Third Guardian
QuestInfo.1: You need the help of the #bGrandis Shadow crew#k. Go talk to #b#p3001004##k.

0.0: #p3000007##k... I remember him when he was young. In terms of battle skills and strength, he was unparalleled, but had a weak will.\r\n#L0# #bWhy would #p3000007# join Magnus? Did...did he really want power so badly?#l\n#k
0.1: I understand that you are shocked, Kaiser, but we accept the reality we are given. Considering #p3000007#'s skills and the size of the army now before us, it would seem that #p3000007# has become Magnus's third guardian. \r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
0.2: What strikes me is that skill he used on you...that's taken straight from Magnus's playbook. You must be ready to cut down #p3000007# without hesitation. He will surely do the same to you.\r\n#L0##bWe may be old friends, but I'm always ready to crush someone that threatens Nova's safety.#l\n#k
0.3: Good. According to the information from #p3001002#, Magnus learned the secrets of the Nova royal family's defenses, and he's using a similar seal.\r\n#L0##bAnd that means...?#l\n#k
0.4: To make a key that can reach the royal throne, you need three seals. The original three guardians had these seals. Victor, Treglow, and...\r\n#L0##bAnd...?#l\n#k
0.5: Goodness, I've had this seal forever. My office actually used to be right across from the throneroom. I hate to think of what the invaders have done to it...\r\n#L0##bHuh.#l\n#k
0.6: Anyway, I'm certain Magnus has made his own seals, and given them to his corrupted guardians. Finding them is going to take some special information from the merchant crew. #p3001002# already sent you to deal with them once, if I recall?

yes.0: Long ago, we had a very close relationship with the merchant crew. They actually played a big part in securing the central region. Go see #b#p3001004##k near #b#m401040000##k.

no.0: You are the only person for this task... Don't forget that.

1.0: Ahhh, my mighty compatriot brightens my day once more! How fare you?\r\n#L0##bFine...but are you sure this is a good place for doing business?#l\n#k
1.1: Indeed! One must be prepared for anything in times of war, not the least of which being the noble pursuit of currency!\r\n#L0##bI barely understand you most of the time, so let's get this over with. Edea sent me.#l\n#k
1.2: So, you are the lucky rogue who shall profit from our agreement. Are you prepared for a shower of knowledge?

yes.0: Good. Shall we speak of #bTreglow#k first? Pause for a moment while I arrange my factoids.
